siteBrief.primaryGoal: Manage real estate, construction, accounting, finance, personnel, rental, collections, payments, banking, checks/notes, invoices, inventory and reporting processes for multiple tenants/companies
siteBrief.audience: Real estate companies, construction firms, property managers, accounting departments, finance teams, property owners, tenants - Turkish market
siteBrief.brandKeywords: Enterprise, multi-tenant, secure, compliant, Turkish-localized, real-estate, construction, accounting, finance, scalable

layoutNotes: Authentication: Login/Register with JWT + Refresh Token, tenant selection
Dashboard: Role-based overview with KPIs, charts, quick actions
Navigation: Persistent sidebar with module groups (Gayrimenkul, İnşaat, Cari/Finans, Muhasebe, Personel, Kira, Banka, Çek/Senet, Fatura, Stok, Raporlar, Ayarlar)
Multi-tenant header: Tenant/company switcher, user profile, notifications, language
Gayrimenkul Module: Proje, Blok, Daire, Ünite, Kira Sözleşmesi, Kiracı, Malik management
İnşaat Module: Yapı Sınıfı (IV-A), Poz/Yapı Malzeme, Metraj, Maliyet, Hakediş, Teknik Şartname
Cari/Finans Module: Cari hesaplar, Tahsilat, Ödeme, Kasa, Banka, Çek/Senet, Fatura
Muhasebe Module: Hesap planı, Muhasebe fişi, Fiş satırları, Borç/Alacak, Mizan, Büyük defter, Bilanço, Gelir tablosu
Personel Module: Personel listesi, İzin, Maaş, Avans, Performans
Kira Module: Kira sözleşmeleri, Tahsilat takibi, Artırım, İndeks, Uyarılar
Banka Module: Banka hesapları, Havale/EFT, Döviz, Banka ekstre mutabakatı
Çek/Senet Module: Çek girişi, Senet girişi, Tahsilat, Protesto, Vade takibi
Fatura Module: E-fatura/E-arşiv, Fatura oluşturma, Gönderim, Durum takibi
Stok Module: Ürün/Hizmet, Depo, Hareket, Sayım, Minimum stok uyarısı
Raporlar Module: Dinamik raporlar, Özet raporlar, Grafikler, Export (PDF/Excel/CSV)
Ayarlar: Tenant ayarları, Kullanıcı/Rol/Yetki, Şirket bilgileri, Vergi dairesi, Numara serileri, Entegrasyonlar
Audit Log: Tüm kritik işlemlerin kayıtlı görüntülenmesi
RTL/Turkish: Türkçe karakter destekli, locale-aware sıralama/arama

typography.usage: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings, UI elements, navigation; Source Sans Pro for body text, tables, forms, data-heavy views

buttons.primary: Solid primary background, white text, rounded-lg, hover: primaryLight
buttons.secondary: Outline primary border, primary text, rounded-lg, hover: primaryLight bg
buttons.ghost: Transparent, primary text, rounded-lg, hover: primaryLight/10 bg
buttons.danger: Solid error background, white text, rounded-lg, hover: error/90
buttons.success: Solid success background, white text, rounded-lg, hover: success/90

inputs.default: Border border, rounded-lg, px-4 py-2.5, focus: ring-2 ring-primary/20 border-primary
inputs.error: Border error, focus: ring-2 ring-error/20 border-error
inputs.success: Border success, focus: ring-2 ring-success/20 border-success

modals.footer: border-t border-border, px-6 py-4, flex justify-end gap-3

sidebar.item: px-4 py-3, rounded-lg, text-textSecondary, hover:bg-primary/10 hover:text-primary, transition-all
sidebar.groupLabel: px-4 py-2, text-xs, font-semibold, uppercase, tracking-wider, text-textMuted

backend.schemaManagement: Elle SQL — db/schema.sql (pg_dump); Django Migration kullanılmaz

dataStandards.turkishCharacters: Full UTF-8 support at all layers
dataStandards.tcKimlikNo: 11 digits, numeric only, masked in lists (123******01)
dataStandards.name: Turkish chars preserved, proper case conversion (i→İ, ı→I)
dataStandards.plaka: Turkish format (34 ABC 123), case/space insensitive comparison
dataStandards.currency: Python Decimal / PostgreSQL NUMERIC, never FLOAT/DOUBLE

dataProtection: Encryption at rest for sensitive fields
Audit logging for all critical operations
inputValidation: DRF serializers + custom validators on backend

migrationStrategy.phase1: Current system analysis (DB models, APIs, users, tenants, permissions, frontend stores, financial modules, accounting modules, data relationships)
migrationStrategy.phase4: Real estate module migration (Gayrimenkul, Proje, Blok, Daire, Ünite, Kira, Kiracı, Malik)
migrationStrategy.phase5: Finance module migration (Cari, Tahsilat, Ödeme, Kasa, Banka, Çek, Senet, Fatura)
migrationStrategy.phase6: Accounting module migration (Hesap planı, Fiş, Satırlar, Mizan, Defter, Bilanço, Gelir tablosu)
migrationStrategy.phase7: Cutover - Frontend switch to new API after all validations
